name: more-options-for-youtube
description: Zen/Firefox extension that filters the YouTube home page

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --ignore-files test docs package.json package-lock.json scripts README.md
scripts.dev: web-ext run --ignore-files test docs package.json package-lock.json scripts README.md --start-url https://www.youtube.com/
scripts.build: web-ext build --overwrite-dest --ignore-files test docs package.json package-lock.json scripts README.md
